events.title: The first website becomes publicly available
events.fact: Tim Berners-Lee shares the World Wide Web project with the public.
events.label: The first website goes public

events.title: Toy Story opens in cinemas
events.fact: Pixar releases the first fully computer-animated feature film.
events.label: Toy Story opens in cinemas

events.title: Pong is released
events.fact: Atari’s arcade table-tennis game becomes an early video-game hit.
events.label: Pong is released

events.title: The first modern Olympics take place
events.fact: Athens hosts the first Games of the modern Olympic era.
events.label: The first modern Olympics

events.title: The first image of a black hole is released
events.fact: The Event Horizon Telescope reveals the black hole in galaxy M87.
events.label: The first black hole image

events.title: Mount Vesuvius buries Pompeii
events.label: Vesuvius buries Pompeii
events.fact: The eruption covers Pompeii in volcanic material, preserving much of the Roman city beneath it.

events.title: The Dutch East India Company is founded
events.label: Dutch East India Company founded
events.fact: The VOC is established by a Dutch charter to organize trade with Asia.

events.title: The London Underground opens
events.label: The London Underground opens
events.fact: The Metropolitan Railway begins carrying passengers between Paddington and Farringdon.

events.title: Steamboat Willie premieres
events.label: Steamboat Willie premieres
events.fact: The animated short helps introduce Mickey Mouse to a wide audience with synchronized sound.

events.title: The US Civil Rights Act is signed
events.label: The US Civil Rights Act is signed
events.fact: President Lyndon B. Johnson signs the landmark law prohibiting discrimination in areas including public accommodations and employment.

events.title: The Colosseum opens in Rome
events.label: The Colosseum opens
events.fact: Emperor Titus inaugurates the huge amphitheater with public games.

events.title: Galileo publishes The Starry Messenger
events.label: Galileo’s Starry Messenger debuts
events.fact: His short book reports telescopic observations of the Moon, stars, and four moons of Jupiter.

events.title: The US ratifies the Thirteenth Amendment
events.label: The Thirteenth Amendment is ratified
events.fact: The amendment abolishes slavery and involuntary servitude, except as punishment for a crime.

events.title: Clyde Tombaugh discovers Pluto
events.label: Clyde Tombaugh discovers Pluto
events.fact: Tombaugh identifies the distant object while comparing photographic plates at Lowell Observatory.

events.title: The Beatles release Sgt. Pepper’s Lonely Hearts Club Band
events.label: The Beatles release Sgt. Pepper
events.fact: The album brings together songs including Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds and A Day in the Life.

events.title: Constantinople is dedicated as a new imperial capital
events.label: Constantinople becomes a capital
events.fact: Constantine formally dedicates the rebuilt city of Byzantium, later known as Constantinople.

events.title: The Mayflower reaches North America
events.label: The Mayflower reaches America
events.fact: The ship arrives at Cape Cod before its passengers establish Plymouth Colony.

events.title: Canadian Confederation takes effect
events.label: Canadian Confederation takes effect
events.fact: Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia, and New Brunswick form the Dominion of Canada on July 1.

events.title: The Empire State Building opens
events.label: The Empire State Building opens
events.fact: The New York skyscraper opens as the tallest building in the world.

events.title: Ray Tomlinson sends network email
events.label: Tomlinson sends network email
events.fact: Tomlinson develops messaging between computers on ARPANET and chooses the @ sign to separate the user and host.

events.title: Vikings raid the monastery at Lindisfarne
events.label: Vikings raid Lindisfarne
events.fact: The attack on the monastery off England’s northeast coast becomes a famous early Viking raid.

events.title: The Royal Society is founded
events.label: The Royal Society is founded
events.fact: A group meeting at Gresham College in London establishes a society for experimental science.

events.title: The Meiji Restoration begins in Japan
events.label: Japan’s Meiji Restoration begins
events.fact: Imperial rule is restored under Emperor Meiji as the Tokugawa shogunate comes to an end.

events.title: The Golden Gate Bridge opens
events.label: The Golden Gate Bridge opens
events.fact: The San Francisco bridge opens first to pedestrians, then to vehicles the following day.

events.title: Martin Cooper makes a public handheld mobile-phone call
events.label: Cooper demonstrates a mobile call
events.fact: The Motorola engineer demonstrates a handheld cellular phone on a New York City street.

events.title: Charlemagne is crowned emperor
events.label: Charlemagne is crowned emperor
events.fact: Pope Leo III crowns the Frankish ruler in Rome on Christmas Day.

events.title: Saint Petersburg is founded
events.label: Saint Petersburg is founded
events.fact: Peter the Great establishes the city on the Neva River, beginning with the Peter and Paul Fortress.

events.title: Swan Lake premieres in Moscow
events.label: Swan Lake premieres
events.fact: Tchaikovsky’s ballet first appears at the Bolshoi Theatre, long before the later production that makes it a classic.

events.title: Orson Welles broadcasts The War of the Worlds
events.label: War of the Worlds airs on radio
events.fact: The radio drama presents part of its alien-invasion story in the style of breaking news bulletins.

events.title: Jaws opens in cinemas
events.label: Jaws opens in cinemas
events.fact: Steven Spielberg’s shark thriller becomes a major summer box-office success.

events.title: The Domesday survey is completed
events.label: The Domesday survey is completed
events.fact: William the Conqueror’s great survey records landholdings and resources across much of England.

events.title: Robinson Crusoe is published
events.label: Robinson Crusoe is published
events.fact: Daniel Defoe’s novel tells the story of a castaway’s long struggle to survive on an island.

events.title: The Brooklyn Bridge opens
events.label: The Brooklyn Bridge opens
events.fact: The suspension bridge opens to connect Manhattan and Brooklyn across the East River.

events.title: ENIAC is publicly unveiled
events.label: ENIAC is publicly unveiled
events.fact: The large electronic computer is demonstrated at the University of Pennsylvania.

events.title: Sony releases the first Walkman
events.label: The first Walkman goes on sale
events.fact: The portable cassette player goes on sale in Japan, making personal music listening easier on the move.

events.title: Marco Polo leaves Venice for Asia
events.label: Marco Polo sets out for Asia
events.fact: Marco sets out with his father and uncle on the journey that takes him to the court of Kublai Khan.

events.title: James Cook lands at Botany Bay
events.label: Cook lands at Botany Bay
events.fact: Endeavour reaches the east coast of Australia during Cook’s first Pacific voyage.

events.title: Coca-Cola is first sold
events.label: Coca-Cola is first sold
events.fact: John Pemberton’s drink is served at Jacobs’ Pharmacy in Atlanta.

events.title: Columbia introduces the long-playing record
events.label: The LP record is introduced
events.fact: The new microgroove vinyl format spins at 33⅓ rpm and holds more music than earlier commercial discs.

events.title: The compact disc makes its commercial debut
events.label: The compact disc goes on sale
events.fact: The first commercial CD players and discs go on sale in Japan before wider international launches.

events.title: Mansa Musa sets out on his pilgrimage to Mecca
events.label: Mansa Musa’s pilgrimage begins
events.fact: The ruler of Mali travels through Cairo on a pilgrimage remembered for its spectacular displays of wealth.

events.title: The first untethered human balloon flight takes place
events.label: First untethered human balloon flight
events.fact: Pilâtre de Rozier and the Marquis d’Arlandes fly over Paris in a Montgolfier hot-air balloon.

events.title: James Naismith invents basketball
events.label: Naismith invents basketball
events.fact: Naismith devises an indoor game using a ball and peach baskets at a school in Springfield, Massachusetts.

events.title: Watson and Crick publish their DNA model
events.label: The DNA double-helix model appears
events.fact: Their Nature paper proposes the double-helix structure, drawing on evidence including X-ray work by other researchers.

events.title: Apple introduces the Macintosh
events.label: Apple introduces the Macintosh
events.fact: The original Macintosh brings a graphical interface and mouse to a new personal-computer audience.

events.title: Constantinople falls to the Ottoman Empire
events.label: Constantinople falls to the Ottomans
events.fact: Sultan Mehmed II captures the city after a siege, bringing the Byzantine Empire to an end.

events.title: Edward Jenner tests a smallpox vaccine
events.label: Jenner tests a smallpox vaccine
events.fact: Jenner uses material from a cowpox lesion in an experiment that helps establish vaccination against smallpox.

events.title: Ethiopia wins the Battle of Adwa
events.label: Ethiopia wins the Battle of Adwa
events.fact: Emperor Menelik II’s forces defeat an Italian army, helping preserve Ethiopia’s independence.

events.title: Rosa Parks is arrested in Montgomery
events.label: Rosa Parks is arrested
events.fact: Her refusal to give up her bus seat helps trigger the Montgomery bus boycott.

events.title: Nintendo launches the Game Boy in Japan
events.label: The Game Boy launches in Japan
events.fact: Nintendo’s handheld game system goes on sale in Japan before reaching North America later that year.

events.title: Vasco da Gama reaches India by sea
events.label: Vasco da Gama reaches India
events.fact: His expedition arrives near Calicut after sailing from Portugal around the southern tip of Africa.

events.title: The Battle of Trafalgar is fought
events.label: The Battle of Trafalgar
events.fact: A British fleet defeats a combined French and Spanish fleet; Admiral Nelson dies during the battle.

events.title: Marie and Pierre Curie announce polonium
events.label: The Curies announce polonium
events.fact: The Curies report a new radioactive element, named for Marie’s native Poland.

events.title: Ghana gains independence
events.label: Ghana gains independence
events.fact: The former Gold Coast becomes independent from Britain under the name Ghana.

events.title: Nelson Mandela is released from prison
events.label: Nelson Mandela leaves prison
events.fact: Mandela walks free from Victor Verster Prison after 27 years of imprisonment.

events.title: Michelangelo’s David is unveiled in Florence
events.label: Michelangelo’s David is unveiled
events.fact: The marble statue is placed outside the Palazzo Vecchio before later being moved indoors.

events.title: Beethoven’s Ninth Symphony premieres
events.label: Beethoven’s Ninth premieres
events.fact: The symphony, whose finale includes the Ode to Joy, is first performed in Vienna.

events.title: The Ford Model T goes into production
events.label: The Model T enters production
events.fact: Ford begins making the car that will bring motoring within reach of many more buyers.

events.title: The Antarctic Treaty is signed
events.label: The Antarctic Treaty is signed
events.fact: Twelve countries sign an agreement reserving Antarctica for peaceful activities and scientific cooperation.

events.title: The Channel Tunnel officially opens
events.label: The Channel Tunnel opens
events.fact: Queen Elizabeth II and President François Mitterrand formally open the rail link between Britain and France.

events.title: Balboa’s expedition reaches the Pacific from Panama
events.label: Balboa reaches the Pacific
events.fact: Vasco Núñez de Balboa crosses the isthmus of Panama and reaches the ocean he calls the South Sea.

events.title: Louis Braille publishes his reading system
events.label: Braille publishes his reading system
events.fact: Braille presents his raised-dot method for reading and writing by touch in a published book.

events.title: Hiram Bingham visits Machu Picchu
events.label: Bingham visits Machu Picchu
events.fact: Local residents guide Bingham to the Inca site; his expedition brings it wider international attention.

events.title: The FDA approves the first oral contraceptive pill
events.label: First contraceptive pill approved
events.fact: Enovid receives US approval for contraceptive use, after an earlier approval for menstrual disorders.

events.title: The first Harry Potter novel is published
events.label: The first Harry Potter book debuts
events.fact: Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone is first published in the United Kingdom by Bloomsbury.

events.title: Mercator publishes his famous world map
events.label: Mercator publishes his world map
events.fact: The map uses the projection that will become especially useful for plotting a constant compass course.

events.title: Morse sends his famous Washington–Baltimore message
events.label: Morse’s famous telegraph message
events.fact: The telegraph demonstration sends the words What hath God wrought between Washington and Baltimore.

events.title: Arthur Wynne’s crossword appears in the New York World
events.label: Wynne’s crossword is published
events.fact: The newspaper publishes Wynne’s diamond-shaped word puzzle, an early milestone in crossword history.

events.title: Telstar 1 launches
events.label: Telstar 1 launches
events.fact: The communications satellite relays television signals across the Atlantic during its mission.

events.title: Euro banknotes and coins enter circulation
events.label: Euro notes and coins arrive
events.fact: Twelve countries introduce euro cash, three years after the currency began in non-cash form.

events.title: The Gregorian calendar is introduced
events.label: Gregorian calendar is introduced
events.fact: Pope Gregory XIII’s calendar reform is first adopted in several Catholic countries; others switch later.

events.title: Gold is discovered at Sutter’s Mill
events.label: Gold is found at Sutter’s Mill
events.fact: James W. Marshall finds gold in California, setting off the California Gold Rush.

events.title: The Trans-Siberian route entirely within Russia is completed
events.label: All-Russian Trans-Siberian route opens
events.fact: Completion of the Amur Railway provides a route to Vladivostok that no longer needs to cross Manchuria.

events.title: Valentina Tereshkova becomes the first woman in space
events.label: Tereshkova flies into space
events.fact: She flies aboard Vostok 6 and spends almost three days orbiting Earth.

events.title: Curiosity lands on Mars
events.label: Curiosity lands on Mars
events.fact: NASA’s rover touches down in Gale crater using a rocket-powered sky crane.
